name: Extended Teaching Dimension of Blockwise-Addressing
details: For the finite Blockwise-Addressing family; the lower endpoint is attained when $d=2$, and no general equality claim is made.
proof: For a finite binary class, $\mathrm{XTD}=\mathrm S$ by Hanneke--Yang's Theorem 13.  Apply this equality to the established Blockwise-Addressing star-number interval $2^d\leq\mathrm S\leq2^{d+1}-1$.
